script_text: Leo, the cosmos just shifted the ground beneath your fire-sign feet — and nothing about this ordinary week will feel ordinary. The Sun, your ruling planet, is blazing through your solar 1st House right now, supercharging your confidence and personal magnetism like never before. Early this week, Mercury forms a supportive trine to your 1st House on Monday and Tuesday, making your words irresistible — negotiate, pitch, speak up. But watch Wednesday carefully: a tense square between Venus in your 7th House and Pluto in your 10th House creates friction in love and career simultaneously. A partner may demand honesty while your professional world pressures you sideways. Thursday becomes your turning point when Jupiter enters your 5th House, opening a floodgate of creative abundance and romantic possibility. By the weekend, Mars sextile your 11th House ignites bold social connections that could turn into profitable collaborations. Best day: Thursday, because Jupiter blesses your 5th House of joy and love. Worst day: Wednesday, because Venus square Pluto stirs power struggles. Keep your crown polished and your boundaries firm this week. Follow for daily updates.
